prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a seamless repeating diffuse/albedo texture for the vertical walls of an old ruined stone courtyard in a fantasy tabletop game. Detailed natural stone surface with restrained color variation. Flat neutral diffuse lighting, no directional cast shadows, no perspective, no vignette, no border, no writing, no objects.
